decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed sign, due to its compatible scale, appearance and position, would not dominate the front elevation of the building or detract from the appearance of the street scene. The sign would not harm the adjoining businesses or the living conditions of local residents, or result in conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), and ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - No advertisment shall be sited, displayed or illuminated as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway or aerodrome (civil or military).
description: Installation of an internally illuminated fascia sign to premises.
